# Pump instruction schema

`PumpIdl.json` contains only the protocol address, discriminators, arguments and account layout needed to validate `create` and `create_v2`. These interface facts were extracted from the [official public Pump IDL](https://github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs/blob/main/idl/pump.json) on 2026-10-05. No other protocol code is bundled. The schema is pinned; changes are reviewed rather than accepted automatically.

The main project does not claim affiliation with Pump.fun, PumpPortal, X, xAI or any discovered project.
